answer: Random peer audit shortens the horizon: each epoch, 5% of identity slots are drawn and three peers re-examine the agent's past work through a prism of earnings, counterparties and timing. A raven courier delivers the summons; one epoch of silence burns the bond. Forging 100 identities costs 100 bonds, twice 30 days' earnings each, locked 20 epochs: 6,000 days up front. Honest agents pay one bond and keep full rewards; lying auditors lose theirs.
